page_title: BOL 1-0 LEC | Bologna v Lecce 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90+2' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
90+2' Juan Miranda (Bologna) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+1' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bologna.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' The corner from Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) is hurriedly cleared.
89' Bologna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
89' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
87' Luca Gotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicola Sansone (Lecce) replacing Patrick Dorgu.
87' The substitution has been made. Ante Rebic (Lecce) has replaced Ylber Ramadani.
86' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giuseppe Collu had an easy-decision to make.

85' 1 - 0 Goal! Juan Miranda clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the bottom right corner. Wladimiro Falcone had no chance of stopping that. 1:0.

84' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bologna are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
82' Here is a change. Remo Freuler is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Lewis Ferguson (Bologna).
82' Stefan Posch (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lorenzo De Silvestri.
82' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
80' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone is prepared to thwart his effort.

78' Juan Miranda (Bologna) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

77' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
76' Luca Gotti prepares a substitution. Hamza Rafia is replaced by Balthazar Pierret (Lecce).
75' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

73' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) wastes a big opportunity. He shoots from the free kick just outside the box, but his poor effort goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
73' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) will take a free kick in a very promising position.
72' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andy Pelmard (Lecce) was quite harsh and Giuseppe Collu didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' Juan Miranda (Bologna) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
70' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) takes the corner which is cleared.
69' Juan Miranda (Bologna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
68' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Santiago Castro will be replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
68' Juan Miranda plays a short pass through to Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
66' Giuseppe Collu shows a yellow card to Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
66' Juan Miranda (Bologna) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
65' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. It's a throw-in for Bologna.
64' The corner from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is cleared away by the defence.
63' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play and Lecce manage to earn a corner.
62' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
60' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Federico Ravaglia comes off the line to clear the ball away.
60' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jens Odgaard trots off the pitch and is replaced by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
57' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nikola Moro as he is replaced by Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).
57' Luca Gotti has decided to substitute Lameck Banda and he is replaced by Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce).
57' Substitution. Andy Pelmard (Lecce) on for Frederic Guilbert.
56' Nikola Moro (Bologna) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
53' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
52' It seems like Juan Miranda (Bologna) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
52' Bologna win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot. Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Giuseppe Collu signals.
51' Lameck Banda (Lecce) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
50' Good movement by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
49' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.

48' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
47' Lameck Banda (Lecce) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Giuseppe Collu has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Santiago Castro (Bologna) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
45+1' Juan Miranda (Bologna) will take a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

45' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Bologna will take a corner.
44' Santiago Castro (Bologna) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
43' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Bologna will take a throw-in.
41' The ball rebounds to Remo Freuler (Bologna) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
40' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
38' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
37' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
37' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bologna win a corner.
36' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
35' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The linesman signals a throw-in for Bologna.
34' Santiago Castro (Bologna) plays a lovely through ball to Dan Ndoye, but he can't beat Wladimiro Falcone and loses the ball.
32' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Hamza Rafia (Lecce).
31' Juan Miranda (Bologna) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
29' Nikola Moro (Bologna) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
28' Nikola Moro (Bologna) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.

27' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle after Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Bologna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
26' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
26' The ball is cleared after Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bologna.

24' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
22' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Santiago Pierotti, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
21' The ball possession is 71:29.
19' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
18' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
17' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball is out of play. Bologna will have a throw-in.
16' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bologna are taking a throw-in.
15' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.

13' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is behind the touchline and Bologna will take a throw-in.
11' Santiago Castro (Bologna) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lecce.
9' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
7' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
6' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to find Jens Odgaard, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
5' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
4' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
3' Juan Miranda (Bologna) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
2' Bologna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

1' Santiago Castro (Bologna) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the top right corner is denied by a decent save from Wladimiro Falcone. It will be a corner kick for Bologna.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Giuseppe Collu will officiate today.
